step_control_calibration_LTE_vs_ERROPTIO.why: the under-driven LATCHED rows (1.3/1.3, 1.57/1.6) die under the committed GEAR+LTE step control at t=553.000 ps (the wave-2 input-word knot) once the latch state closes the loop onto the clamp conductance (observer latches and PWL-controlled clamps with the same B-source current both run clean; ERROPTION=1 runs clean); those two rows are scored with ERROPTION=1 and labelled; the calibration pair bounds the deviation at <1 mV / <0.1 ps

shape_question (does constant-current ri.pre_stated: NO; establishment 5-15 ps EARLIER on links 2-5
shape_question (does constant-current ri.verdict: FALSIFIED in direction: not earlier; within -0.5..+4.7 ps of the linear ramp (two links beyond the 3 ps falsifier). Cause: the rail is only at 1.375 V at the boundary, the demand is trajectory-dependent

standing_eye_center_row.verdict: FALSIFIED (narrower by 2.4 ps; widening appears only at I_f=1.3 or I_r=1.9)

fixed_mode_boundary_mismatch.pre_stated: dV at tt: -0.16 V at 1.3 mA, +0.19 V overshoot at 1.9 mA
fixed_mode_boundary_mismatch.verdict: FALSIFIED: constant current ALWAYS under-delivers in voltage (1.235/1.375/1.468 V at 1.3/1.57/1.9 mA), no overshoot anywhere; the same 145 fC as a 0.86->2.29 mA two-slope reaches 1.577 V. Shape, not just charge, sets the arrival.

latched_arrival_error.pre_stated: Q/I arithmetic: +19.5 ps at 1.3, -0.3 ps at 1.57, -15.7 ps at 1.9; all PASS
latched_arrival_error.verdict: FALSIFIED: 1.9 mA arrives +32.8 ps LATE (needs ~237 fC vs the ramp's 145), 1.57 mA arrives +66 ps late where it arrives at all (9/15 bank-waves never), 1.3 mA never; both under-driven latched rows FAIL value/eye/handoff

tolerance_band.pre_stated: FIXED: all 9 PASS; LATCHED PASS at 1.57 and 1.9, 1.3 at risk
tolerance_band.verdict: FIXED confirmed (9/9 PASS) but erosion is steep below 1.57 mA (I_r=1.3: margin 136-286 mV, overlap 8-28 ps, ERODES_SLOW at I_f=2.0); LATCHED falsified below 1.9 mA
